data.value:
------------更新医院科室信息触发更新时间------------ IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.triggers WHERE name = N'trigger_refresh_location' ) DROP TRIGGER trigger_refresh_location GO
CREATE TRIGGER [trigger_refresh_location] ON [Locations] AFTER INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE AS BEGIN update [Locations] set ST_Location = GETDATE() END GO ------------更新医院科室信息触发更新时间------------
------------更新setup信息触发更新时间------------ IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.triggers WHERE name = N'trigger_update_refresh_setup' ) DROP TRIGGER trigger_update_refresh_setup GO
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trigger_update_refresh_setup] ON [dbo].[NovaSetups] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update [dbo].[Locations] set ST_Setup = GETDATE() where Id in (select LocationId from deleted) END GO ------------END 更新setup信息触发更新时间------------
------------更新TestRange信息触发更新时间------------ IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.triggers WHERE name = N'trigger_insert_testrange_refresh_setup' ) DROP TRIGGER trigger_insert_testrange_refresh_setup GO
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trigger_insert_testrange_refresh_setup] ON [dbo].[TestRanges] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update [dbo].[Locations] set ST_Setup = GETDATE() where Id in (select Id from inserted) END GO ------------END 更新TestRange信息触发更新时间------------
------------更新TestRange信息触发更新时间------------ IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.triggers WHERE name = N'trigger_update_testrange_refresh_setup' ) DROP TRIGGER trigger_update_testrange_refresh_setup GO
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trigger_update_testrange_refresh_setup] ON [dbo].[TestRanges] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update [dbo].[Locations] set ST_Setup = GETDATE() where Id in (select Id from deleted) END GO ------------END 更新TestRange信息触发更新时间------------

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trigger_insert_preferences_refresh_setup] ON [dbo].[Preferences] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update [dbo].[Locations] set ST_Setup = GETDATE() where Id in (select Id from inserted) END GO ------------END 新增Preference信息触发更新时间------------
------------更新Preference信息触发更新时间------------ IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.triggers WHERE name = N'trigger_update_preferences_refresh_setup' ) DROP TRIGGER trigger_update_preferences_refresh_setup GO
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trigger_update_preferences_refresh_setup] ON [dbo].[Preferences] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @id int;
select @id = Id from deleted
update [dbo].[Locations] set ST_Setup = GETDATE() where Id in (select Id from deleted) END GO ------------END 更新Preference信息触发更新时间------------

END GO ------------END 新增Diagcode信息触发更新时间------------
